@@ -1,9 +1,13 @@
 import { store } from './store'
 import { metrics } from './metrics'

-/** Persist a draft and record that it was saved. */
+/**
+ * Persist a draft and record that it was saved. The editor calls this on every
+ * keystroke, so the handler no longer blocks on the round-trip to storage.
+ */
 export async function saveDraft(draft: Draft): Promise<void> {
   validate(draft)
-  await store.put(draft.id, draft)
+  // Fire the write and let the editor carry on.
+  store.put(draft.id, draft)
   metrics.increment('draft.saved')
 }

skills.name: bug-hunter
skills.content: You are a correctness-focused reviewer. Flag off-by-one errors, boundary mistakes, unawaited promises, null/undefined hazards, and logic bugs that change observable behavior. Ignore style and naming.

skills.name: reliability-reviewer
skills.content: You review for production reliability: lost writes, silent failures, unhandled rejections, and telemetry that reports success the system cannot actually guarantee. Ignore style, naming and performance micro-optimizations.
